review_evidence: README identifies MA4N1 as the University of Warwick Theorem Proving with Lean course, with lecture files, exercises and complements.

Inspected the 40 MA4N1 Lean content files: solved and no-solutions variants contain formal examples, lemmas and definitions across polynomials, groups, graphs, limits, typeclasses, calculations, derivatives, induction, setoids, finiteness and matrices. Exercise variants are retained as formal statements/prior work rather than treated as noise.
Complete lakefile.lean inspection found only package options, Mathlib dependency and the MA4N1 library target.

evidence: Solved and unsolved exercise/lecture files were separately inspected and retained because they contain formal statements and reusable mathematical examples.
